result.description:
Sutherland Shire is located at the southern coastal border of the Sydney metropolitan area, about 26 kilometres from the Sydney CBD, is 369km2 in area and home to over 227,300 people.

Web: http://www.sutherlandshire.nsw.gov.au

Floodplain Management has been considered for:

* Bundeena
* Deadmans Creek
* Dents Creek
* Ewey Creek
* Georges River
* Gwawley Bay Catchment
* Kurnell Township
* Oyster Creek
* Woolooware Bay Catchment
* Woronora River

http://www.sutherlandshire.nsw.gov.au/Outdoors/Environment/Flooding
